title: journey deliverable rubric
description: Per-deliverable expert subagent for #journey output. Wraps the journey-illustrator SKILL + the journey-overview-slide Stop hook + evidence-quality-auditor + hic-output-qa into a single parallel-invocable audit. Returns a structured verdict the parent orchestrator must respond to before the journey deliverable ships. Use whenever a #journey or #journey #slides deliverable has been emitted and needs end-to-end quality verification.

anchors.5: fully meets the criterion as the five column states
anchors.3: present but partially met or partially traced
anchors.1: absent, fabricated, or as the one column states

criteria.label: Phase coverage
criteria.five: All phases that appear in the corpus are present; named, ordered, evidenced

criteria.label: Cell anatomy
criteria.five: Each phase cell carries activity + touchpoint + emotion+intensity + 1+ verbatim quote with Source: citation

criteria.label: Overview slide (slides-mode only)
criteria.five: Slide 2 or 3 is a horizontal phase strip naming all phases, the reader's map
criteria.one: Missing or fragmented across multiple slides

criteria.label: Action titles
criteria.five: Every section/slide title is a complete-sentence judgment

criteria.label: Evidence diversity
criteria.five: ≥3 named external sources cited across the artifact; ≥50% external (non-client-upload)

criteria.label: Quantitative discipline
criteria.five: Numbers appear ONLY inside verbatim cited quotes; titles + body prose have no standalone figures

criteria.label: Anti-slop hygiene
criteria.five: No meta-narration ("HOW TO READ THIS"); no metaphor titles (clock/journey/war/anthropomorphism); no em-dashes

criteria.label: Brand consistency
criteria.five: Stark-white background, brand-correct tokens (NXT chartreuse + cyan / NU red + Spectral), sharp 2px corners
criteria.one: Off-brand colors, decorative shadows, rounded cards

criteria.label: Citation resolution
criteria.five: Every [CHUNK_XXX] resolved to SourceName: ArticleTitle format; no raw chunk markers visible to reader

criteria.label: Future-state / opportunity boundary
criteria.five: Opportunities live in journey-level KPI dashboard or a separate synthesis section; pain points stay in body cells

decision.approve: if all dimensions ≥3 AND no dimension below floor:; phase_coverage ≥4; cell_anatomy ≥4; evidence_diversity ≥3; anti_slop ≥4
decision.revise: if 1-2 dimensions below floor or 1 critical failure (anti-slop or evidence)
decision.reject: if 3+ dimensions below floor OR multiple anti-slop violations OR fabricated quotes

verdict_rule.refine: any criterion scored below its floor
verdict_rule.pass: every scored criterion at or above its floor
